metadata.independence_basis: Used only filed governance artifacts and read-only in-memory probes. No implementer conversation, reasoning, unfiled explanation, Git state, product content, service, product test, database, seed or migration execution was used.

reviewed: exact 103-file governance commit manifest and binding code
scanner sources and filed scanner fixtures
filed lifecycle projection and residual-risk artifacts
excluded: Git, services, product tests, database, seed and migration execution

findings.evidence: The structured contract promises json-string-unescape-once. The implementation manually replaces only escaped slash, quote and backslash, while its JSON.parse branch first re-escapes every backslash and therefore preserves a legal JSON Unicode escape rather than unescaping it. A credential URI whose initial scheme character is represented as a JSON Unicode escape returns no finding. The filed fixture covers escaped slashes only, yet the filed security evidence claims completion of the declared contract.
findings.reproduction: node --input-type=module -e "import {scanText} from './.codex/scripts/lib/secret-scanner.mjs'; const b=String.fromCharCode(92); const v=b+'u0070ostgresql:'+b+'/'+b+'/fixture_user:'+'Synthetic9Value'+'@host.invalid/db'; console.log(scanText(v,'probe'));"
findings.impact: A manifest-included governance text file can contain an in-contract JSON-escaped credential URI while the exact-manifest scan reports no finding. This invalidates the declared-contract clean claim.

findings.evidence: The contract lists Authorization, Cookie and Set-Cookie as covered header classes, separately from the token-pattern list. The scanner detects only Authorization Bearer and rejects a generic Cookie only when its value is unquoted. Read-only probes returned no finding for a Basic Authorization credential and for a quoted generic Cookie value. The filed fixtures exercise Bearer, one unquoted Cookie, one unquoted Set-Cookie and a short safe Cookie; they do not close these declared header variants.
reproduction: node --input-type=module -e "import {scanText} from './.codex/scripts/lib/secret-scanner.mjs'; const v='Authorization: Basic '+Buffer.from(['user','Synthetic9Value'].join(':')).toString('base64'); console.log(scanText(v,'probe'));"

node --input-type=module -e "import {scanText} from './.codex/scripts/lib/secret-scanner.mjs'; const q=String.fromCharCode(34); const v='Coo'+'kie: id='+q+['Ab9Cd8','Ef7Gh6','Ij5Kl4Mn'].join('')+q; console.log(scanText(v,'probe'));"
findings.expected: A declared Authorization or Cookie header finding for each credential-bearing vector.
findings.impact: Credential-bearing declared header classes can enter a manifest-included text artifact without invalidating the no-findings claim.

findings.evidence: The contract declares opaque-high-entropy-value with minimum length 32 and threshold 4.2. Candidate extraction accepts only contiguous standard Base64 characters. A synthetic mixed-case, numeric, URL-safe opaque value split by an underscore has no 32-character contiguous standard-Base64 segment and returns no finding despite meeting the declared opaque-value class. Only one standard-alphanumeric entropy positive is filed, with no adjacent URL-safe positive or entropy-specific safe negative.
findings.expected: A HIGH_ENTROPY_OPAQUE_VALUE finding or an explicit structured contract restriction excluding URL-safe opaque values.
findings.impact: An in-contract high-entropy opaque value can evade the deterministic manifest scan, so the filed no-findings-within-declared-contract claim is not trustworthy.

findings.evidence: The contract lists extension-magic-mismatch, but scanBinaryContent never compares ref extension or manifest artifact_type with detected magic and never emits that class. A PDF signature in probe.txt is rejected as PDF_SIGNATURE, but the claimed extension-magic-mismatch control is absent. The filed binary fixtures cover only MZ and ELF positives and do not provide the declared signature matrix or adjacent safe negatives. Remediation 4 nevertheless marks the scanner root cause IMPLEMENTED and the deterministic contract scan completed.
findings.observed: PDF_SIGNATURE is emitted; EXTENSION_MAGIC_MISMATCH is not emitted.
findings.expected: The declared mismatch control is implemented and tested, or removed from the structured contract. Positive and safe-negative fixtures cover MZ, ELF, ZIP, PDF, SQLite, PGDMP, OLE, PNG, JPEG, NUL, binary ratio and extension/type mismatch.
findings.impact: Known binary signatures are presently rejected, but the structured capability and regression-coverage claim is materially broader than the implemented control. The A3 completion criterion for deterministic rejection fixtures plus adjacent safe negatives is not met.

conditions.condition: Implement a real single-pass JSON string unescape and apply the declared bounded canonicalization consistently, then add positive and adjacent safe-negative regression vectors.
conditions.completion_criterion: The SEC-A4-001 vector deterministically rejects, legal safe JSON escapes remain accepted, and the refreshed exact-manifest scan passes.

conditions.condition: Make Authorization, Cookie and Set-Cookie behavior match the structured contract, including credential-bearing non-Bearer Authorization and quoted cookie values, or narrowly revise the contract before regenerating evidence.
conditions.completion_criterion: Both SEC-A4-002 vectors reject, adjacent harmless header/cookie negatives pass, and filed fixtures enumerate the supported variants.

conditions.condition: Align opaque entropy candidate extraction with the declared minimum-length contract, including URL-safe characters, with bounded false-positive handling expressed as findings rather than silent omission.
conditions.completion_criterion: The SEC-A4-003 vector produces a finding and safe hash, identifier, placeholder and prose negatives remain accepted.

conditions.condition: Implement or remove the extension-magic-mismatch claim and add a complete positive/safe-negative binary matrix for every declared signature and ratio control.
conditions.completion_criterion: The filed contract, implementation finding classes and fixture assertions agree exactly for MZ, ELF, ZIP, PDF, SQLite, PGDMP, OLE, PNG, JPEG, NUL, binary-control-ratio and extension/type mismatch.

conditions.condition: After any scanner, contract, fixture or evidence change, regenerate the governance commit manifest, candidate snapshot and A4 before baseline, then obtain a new clean-context Security Review.
conditions.completion_criterion: The replacement baseline has exact included paths and hashes, no unscanned included file, no hash drift, and no unresolved formal Security finding.

decisions_required.question: Choose the bounded mandatory header, canonicalization, entropy and extension/type contract. The current false negatives cannot be accepted while retaining the current structured contract and no-findings claim.

reproducible_read_only_checks.method: Import scanText and scanBinaryContent in Node memory and apply synthetic positive and safe-negative vectors without filesystem writes.
reproducible_read_only_checks.observed: Raw credential userinfo passed for postgres, postgresql, mysql, mongodb, mongodb+srv, redis, rediss, amqp, amqps, http, https, ftp, sftp and ssh. One-pass and two-pass URL decoding passed. Escaped-slash JSON passed; legal JSON Unicode unescape failed. Bearer, unquoted Cookie/Set-Cookie, session, sessionid, connect.sid, jwt, access_token, refresh_token, private key, JWT, known service token and standard-alphanumeric entropy passed; Basic Authorization, quoted Cookie and URL-safe entropy failed. MZ, ELF, ZIP, PDF, SQLite, PGDMP, OLE, PNG, JPEG, NUL and binary-control-ratio passed; safe plain text passed; extension-magic-mismatch class failed.

The filed scanner-specific remediation cases cover rediss, amqps, sftp, percent encoding, escaped slash JSON, Cookie, Set-Cookie, one entropy positive, MZ, ELF and only URI/Cookie safe negatives; the 50-case suite adds Bearer, one PostgreSQL URI and PDF. It does not provide complete declared-class positive and adjacent safe-negative coverage.

exact_candidate_content_scan.limitation: This establishes only no findings from the current implementation over the exact 103 included files; it cannot cure the declared-contract false negatives.

positive_and_safe_negative_fixture_cover.reason: Filed fixtures do not enumerate every declared scanner class with adjacent safe negatives and do not expose the reproduced false negatives.

manifest_external_boundary.statement: The exact clean-scan claim is limited to the 103 manifest-included files. Local review records and hash-bound external references marked commit_inclusion=false are not claimed as scanned or globally clean. commit_inclusion=false is classification metadata, not proof of Git isolation, staging, branch protection or remote controls.

residual_risks.statement: No .env content was read; OS permissions still do not deny reads of ignored .env files, and the safe profile is not runtime isolation.
Node child_process can bypass profile validation and execute commands outside the profile contract.
PowerShell and cmd.exe can bypass profile validation; no command interception or executable allowlist is enforced.
Arbitrary executables and a parent permission override may bypass or broaden the Agent profile.
Product start and test scripts are not wired to the safety validator while product roots remain Phase 1 locked.
Branch, commit and worktree are repository-global human operations; branch protection, CODEOWNERS, required review, CI, remote state and actual staging were not established.
Clean reviewer context and human identity assurance are procedural rather than cryptographic.
Agent path policy and change-scope validation are not an OS-level filesystem sandbox.
Canonical path and reparse checks reduce but cannot eliminate Windows reparse and filesystem TOCTOU risks.
The Domain index remains an incomplete proposed Rule registry; candidate Rules are not confirmed by this review.
No controlled external artifact store or retention policy is configured.
Pattern scanning can produce false positives and cannot prove absence of every novel, fragmented, compressed, encrypted, renamed, unknown or multiply encoded secret; it is not DLP.
External Migration 320 evidence is manifest-external, includes operational path and dump-reference classifications, and was not verified globally clean.
Fixture isolation reduces known cleanup collisions, but a hard crash can retain a run and no lock proves immunity from every filesystem race.
Phase 1 provides a traceability projection, not a complete Knowledge Graph backend.
Migration 320 remains NO-GO; no product, database, seed or migration evidence was expanded by this review.

candidate_review_gate_implication.reason: A formal Security Reviewer returned BLOCKER with demonstrated in-contract false negatives and a false structured scanner capability claim.
candidate_review_gate_implication.required_next_step: Remediate the scanner and fixture contract, regenerate the exact candidate baseline, and obtain a fresh independent A4 Security Review. Do not rewrite this Reviewer outcome.
